name: remote-file
description: Manage files on remote hosts over SSH with ownership and permissions

command:
set -eu
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then export SSHPASS="$SSH_PASS"; fi
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then
  SSH_CMD=(sshpass -e ssh)
else
  SSH_CMD=(ssh -o BatchMode=yes)
fi
REMOTE_SCRIPT='export RF_PATH='\''/etc/motd'\''
export RF_MAKE_PARENTS='\''1'\''
export RF_SUDO='\''0'\''
set -eu
run() {
  if [ "${RF_SUDO:-0}" = '\''1'\'' ]; then
    printf '\''%s\n'\'' "${RF_SUDO_PASS:-}" | sudo -S -p '\'''\'' "$@"
  else
    "$@"
  fi
}
if [ "${RF_MAKE_PARENTS:-1}" = '\''1'\'' ]; then
  DIR=$(dirname "$RF_PATH")
  run install -d "$DIR"
fi
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP"
run install -m "${RF_MODE:-0644}" "$TMP" "$RF_PATH"
rm -f "$TMP"
if [ -n "${RF_OWNER:-}${RF_GROUP:-}" ]; then
  OWN="${RF_OWNER:-}"
  if [ -n "${RF_GROUP:-}" ]; then
    OWN="${OWN}:${RF_GROUP}"
  fi
  run chown "$OWN" "$RF_PATH"
fi
sha256sum "$RF_PATH" | awk '\''{print $1}'\''
'
REMOTE_CMD="bash -c $(printf %q "$REMOTE_SCRIPT")"
cat 'files/motd' | "${SSH_CMD[@]}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -p '22' 'root@h.example' "$REMOTE_CMD"
